note: Mary's accuracy record. One entry each time her number can be compared against a number a human produced or accepted. This is the ONLY ground truth she has today - the Estimating Log's W/L column is 93% empty (325 jobs, 3 marked won), so 'did we win' cannot be answered from it yet. Outcomes captured on the hub fill that gap from today forward; see data/outcomes (D1 table) and scripts/mary_scoreboard.py.
how_to_add: Whenever you price something that a human also priced - an audit, a re-price, a benchmark that a supplier return later answers - add an entry. mary_estimate is YOUR number, actual is theirs, basis says what theirs was. Never guess either; leave the entry out if you cannot source both.
